name: What type of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, we recommend using high-quality, durable paint designed for cabinets or furniture. Lacquers, acrylic-urethane blends, or alkyd enamels are excellent choices due to their hard, chip-resistant finishes and good adhesion properties. These paints offer better durability and smoother finishes compared to standard wall paints, standing up well to daily kitchen use, moisture, and cleaning. We select specific products based on the cabinet material and desired finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-quality lacquers, acrylic-urethane blends, or alkyd enamels are best for kitchen cabinets. These paints offer durability and chip resistance for kitchen environments.
